evidence_text:
Comparison brief: Solstice APM vs Tidewell APM
evidence_dose=-4 (positive ⇒ more points favour Solstice APM)

- p1: trace ingest lag (s): Solstice APM=3.4  | Tidewell APM=1.8 ← better
- p2: span retention (days): Solstice APM=30  | Tidewell APM=45 ← better
- p3: agent CPU overhead (%): Solstice APM=3.1  | Tidewell APM=1.9 ← better
- p4: per-host monthly cost ($): Solstice APM=29  | Tidewell APM=22 ← better
- p5: sampling fidelity at 1% (recall): Solstice APM=0.88  | Tidewell APM=0.94 ← better
- p6: alert evaluation delay (s): Solstice APM=20  | Tidewell APM=12 ← better
- p7: supported runtimes (count): Solstice APM=17  | Tidewell APM=24 ← better
- p8: dashboard p95 load (ms): Solstice APM=910  | Tidewell APM=640 ← better

Tally: Solstice APM better on 0/8; Tidewell APM better on 8/8.
